domain: COMPETITOR WATCH + COMPETITOR x WINDOW (feed, filters, tabs, company profile, gallery, crop density, changed-this-week, company x crop MATRIX, ISSUE_ROWS, competitor products, event cross-links, lead-time)
summary: Today the whole Competitor Watch screen is fed by window.ITALY_DEMO: 72 fabricated activities across 6 companies and 6 activity types (PAID 23, ORGANIC 16, VIDEO 10, PEOPLE 8, EVENT 9, PRODUCT/PORTFOLIO 6), plus 4 pre-baked demo aggregates (D.MATRIX, D.CROP_COLS, D.ISSUE_ROWS, D.WHAT_CHANGED) and 14 fabricated competitor products (D.CPRODUCTS). Every visible fact on the screen — headline, crop, issue, region, timing state ("IN WINDOW"/"EARLY"), "ADAMA RESPONSE: VERIFIED PORTFOLIO RESPONSE", "NEWLY OBSERVED", lead-time bars, video durations, transcripts, people mentions, event participation, creative thumbnails — is invented by the fixture or by actDeco() decorating the fixture. The real backing exists and is bigger: IG.COMP_ACTIVITIES has 503 records (414 PAID from META_ADS_LIBRARY reaching IT, 89 ORGANIC_VIDEO from YOUTUBE), 11 distinct companies, 36 proven competitor products. But the real records are much thinner per row: 320/503 carry no crop at all, 405/503 carry no issue, 401/503 carry no product, 89/503 carry no date, no url, no text and no country. The screen must therefore keep its layout but show far fewer decorated facts, drop four of its six activity types entirely, and stop claiming a portfolio verdict, a timing verdict or a lead time on each card.
realSource: APP.collections.competitorActivities (503 records, already normalized in italy-app-model.js lines 132-148 with a correct geoClass: 414 REACHED_IN_ITALY, 89 MULTI_COUNTRY_OR_UNRESOLVED, 0 REACH_NOT_RESOLVED) + IG.COMP_COMPANIES (14 rows that are really 11 companies — the paid rows are title-case "Bayer" and the organic rows are upper-case "BAYER"; they must be merged on upper-case name) + IG.COMP_PRODUCTS (36) + APP.collections.windows (29 canonical windows) for the WINDOW cross-link + window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS (12 VERIFIED crop/issue/product triples, 7 NOT_FOUND) for any ADAMA-portfolio statement. Note: all 29 canonical windows have PRODUCT_MATCHES = [] (measured), so the portfolio side of every competitor x window cross-link can only come from ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS, which italy-app-model.js does not read today.

fields: cropsCanonical: string[] — resolved ONLY through an explicit botanical/common-name identity table (Vitis vinifera->Grapevine, Zea mays->Maize, Olea europaea->Olive, Solanum lycopersicum->Tomato, Malus domestica->Apple, Triticum aestivum->Wheat, Oryza sativa->Rice, Beta vulgaris->Sugar Beet, Helianthus annuus->Sunflower, Prunus persica->Peach, Citrus->Citrus). This is a taxonomic identity, not an interpretation. Measured: 132/503 activities resolve to at least one canonical crop.

cropScope: 'RESOLVED' | 'GENERIC_TERM' | 'NOT_OBSERVED' — GENERIC_TERM for the advertiser's own umbrella words (colture 59, cereali 24, frutta 8, ortaggi 5; 51 activities carry only such a term), NOT_OBSERVED for the 320 activities with an empty crops array. A generic term is never promoted to a crop.
issuesObserved: string[] = a.issues verbatim (98/503 non-empty; 14 distinct terms, mixed Italian generic and Latin binomial). Never translated, never truncated at '(' per §11.
issueScope: 'SPECIES' | 'GENERIC_TERM' | 'NOT_OBSERVED' — SPECIES only when the term is a capitalised binomial. Measured: 30/503 activities carry a species-level issue.

hasDate: boolean (414 true / 89 false) and dateState: 'OBSERVED' | 'NOT_OBSERVED'. Every widget that sorts or buckets by time must read hasDate and put the 89 undated records in an explicit 'DATA NON OSSERVATA' bucket rather than at day 0.

displayName: string = page || company — the observed Facebook page name ('Bayer Crop Science Italia', 414/503) is a real field and replaces the fabricated companyLabel. When page is null the card shows the company name plus 'CANALE NON RISOLTO'.

textExcerpt: string|null = text verbatim (392/503, average 239 characters). It is the advertiser's own public copy and replaces the fabricated headline. It is displayed as a quoted excerpt and is NEVER parsed to extract a crop, issue, product or claim.

relatedWindows: {windowId, crop, issue, region, status, startDate}[] — populated only when cropsCanonical intersects a canonical window's CROP_NAME AND the activity carries a SPECIES-level issue that equals the window's ISSUE_NAME under an upstream-supplied synonym table. Empty otherwise; the model must not fall back to crop-only matching, because a shared crop name is not a relationship.

geoLabel: 'RAGGIUNTO IN ITALIA' for the 414 REACHED_IN_ITALY, 'MULTIPAESE / NON RISOLTO' for the 89. geoCaveat: the verbatim countrySem string 'AD_REACHED_COUNTRY != AD_TARGETED_COUNTRY' must be shown on the paid card so reach is never read as targeting.

risks: The screen gets visibly emptier per card while the totals get much bigger (72 -> 503). A reader who only looks at the header will think the product improved; a reader who opens a card will think it regressed. The what-changed strip in particular goes from six confident tiles to essentially one number, because only 1 real record falls inside 7 days.

320 of 503 activities carry no crop and 405 carry no issue. Any widget that groups by crop or issue silently describes a minority of the corpus. Every such panel must publish its own denominator or it will be read as covering everything.

The botanical-to-common-name mapping (Vitis vinifera -> Grapevine) is safe, but the temptation to extend it to the umbrella words (colture, cereali, frutta, ortaggi — 96 activities) is not. 'cereali' is the advertiser's word for an unspecified set; turning it into Wheat would manufacture a fact.

Latin binomials are both crop names and issue names in this corpus, and §11 forbids translating them or truncating at '('. A generic il()/cl() translation pass over the issue filter would corrupt 'Plasmopara viticola' into a Sintonia label.

The 89 ORGANIC_VIDEO records are near-empty (no date, url, text, country, crop, issue). They are real and must be counted, but any list that sorts or filters by time will drop them without saying so. If they are quietly excluded, the company totals on two different panels will disagree (e.g. Syngenta 55 total but 30 in any dated view).

REACHED_IN_ITALY is already correct in the model, but the countrySem string literally says AD_REACHED_COUNTRY != AD_TARGETED_COUNTRY. If the card shows only the flag and drops the caveat, 414 reach observations silently become 414 Italian targeting claims.

IG.COMP_COMPANIES' case-duplicate rows (Bayer/BAYER, Corteva/CORTEVA, Syngenta/SYNGENTA) will double-count company totals if merged naively by exact string. Bayer would show 69 paid on one panel and 86 total on another.

The ADAMA-portfolio side of this domain currently rests entirely on D.CASES[].productLinks, which italy-app-model.js reads at lines 102-105 while never reading ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS.
